messages:
inc-bot: PAGING: metering-aggregator: shadow-agg downstream lag detected (error-rate spike + missing heartbeats). Severity: P2. docs: https://infra/redwood/incidents/meet
lyra-oncall: ack. jumping in, pulling up dashboards now :eyes:
sam-sre: seeing a divergence between live counts and shadow-agg window. token delta trending +12% over last 30m. traces show delayed commits from aggregator v1.9.2
maya-billing: are customers getting overage flags? any customer-facing alerts fired?
lyra-oncall: support reported a few automated overage emails from yesterday's batch. looks like delayed windows doubled some customers' daily counts. not widespread yet.
toni-support: 3 customers flagged in last 24h. IDs: C-1324, C-8721, C-9902. I can open follow-ups after triage.
rahul-eng: ingest workers intermittently fail ack to emitter with:
```
WARN emitter: failed ack: HTTP 502 from token-proxy (timeout) \n2026-03-15T21:13:02Z stack: emitter/ack.go:87
```
rahul-eng: suspect transient proxy saturation + heartbeat skip in aggregate windowing logic
sam-sre: rolling metrics: write latency from aggregator -> db spiked to 6s at 20:12Z, commit backlog grew to ~1.2M events
lyra-oncall: mitigation plan: 1) scale aggregator replicas x2 2) enable ack-retry shim on emitter 3) temporarily pause billing job that consumes shadow counts (prevent new overage mails)
rahul-eng: executing scale now: `kubectl scale deployment/meters-agg --replicas=6 -n prod`
inc-bot: deploybot: rollout started for meters-agg (deployment/meters-agg) by rahul-eng. link: https://deploys/redwood/rollouts/9876
sam-sre: hitting resource limits on one node, moving scaled pods across nodes. also need to increase DB write pool size, planning small change to pgbouncer
lyra-oncall: pausing billing consumer: `POST /admin/billing/consumers/shadow/pause` -> response 200
maya-billing: confirmed consumer paused, stopping automated overage emails now. initiating temporary suppression window for affected accounts.
toni-support: I'll draft one-off message to those three customers explaining we saw delayed aggregation and we're suppressing alerts while we reconcile.
jenna-pm: can we estimate how many customers could be affected? will this change invoices?
maya-billing: initial estimate ~0.2% of active accounts might have transient double-count in last 48h. we'll reconcile with backfill and credit as needed. finance loop-in if invoices already generated.
rahul-eng: backfill strategy: replay aggregator commit backlog from S3 snapshot -> run reconcile pipeline with dedupe token. starting job `replay-backfill 2026-03-15T20:00Z 2026-03-15T22:30Z --dedupe`
sam-sre: also enabling KV-cache guard to reject duplicate windows: `featureflag set window-dedupe on` (rolling flag)
lyra-oncall: monitoring: dashboards from now. if delta drops <0.5% for 30m we'll call mitigated.
inc-bot: ALERT update: error-rate decreased 70% after scale and retries. ongoing backfill job queued.
rahul-eng: backfill logs excerpt:
```
INFO replay: read 1,234,567 events \nINFO dedupe: removed 48,321 duplicates \nINFO write: 1,186,246 committed
```
maya-billing: after backfill run 1 snapshot looks good. counts reconciling toward expected; customers C-1324 and C-8721 show corrected totals. C-9902 had an overlap with a promo spike; flagged for manual review.
toni-support: sent interim note to customers: "We're investigating inflated usage alerts; we've paused automated notifications and will update by EOD." :white_check_mark:
sam-sre: root cause hypothesis: proxy timeout + aggregator window edge-case when heartbeat skips, causing event duplication at aggregation boundary. ticket filed: INFRA-4482
lyra-oncall: handing off to gina-next-oncall for overnight watch. summary pinned below.
gina-next-oncall: acked. I'll keep alert thresholds tightened and watch the reconciliation job. ping me if anything resurfaces.
jenna-pm: thanks all. action items for next steps: 1) infra to harden proxy timeouts & retries (rahul) 2) add alert for window-drift >1% (sam) 3) billing to prepare credit playbook (maya) 4) customer comms template (toni)
maya-billing: noted. prepping credit estimate template.
lyra-oncall: closing live pager — incident status: Mitigated (backfill in progress, consumer paused, customer notifications suppressed). handoff complete. :thumbsup:
inc-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated, incident_id=INF-2026-03-15-87, severity=P2, severity_history=[P1->P2], timeline_url=https://incidents/redwood/INF-2026-03-15-87
